superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Observerove razdvojene maksimume čestica u ovom ažuriranju: Stojčino brdo beleži oba maksimuma, dok Bežanijska kosa—ne bilo koja od prethodno navedenih lokacija—beleži maksimum NO2. Ne mogu Connectorov pad mrežnih maksimuma da pretvorim u pad na svakoj stanici; ova poređenja prate maksimume, a ne putanje pojedinačnih stanica. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F7][F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Observer’s separated particulate peaks in this update: Stojčino brdo holds both maxima, while Bežanijska kosa—not either previously named location—holds the NO2 maximum [F4][F8][F6]. I cannot turn Connector’s falling network maxima into a decline at every station; these comparisons track maxima, not individual station trajectories [F5][F7][F9].
